listing.name: NEON's ship pack (v3.0.5.8)
listing.summary: A Vanilla+ Ship Pack which adds a curated selection of vessels to the main factions of the sector, alongside adding onto existing vanilla exploration content.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a curated selection of vessels to the main factions and expands on existing vanilla exploration content.

changelog.3.0.3: Implemented Incursor, Dominator (LP), and Hammerhead (LP) class vessels. Removed missile autoforge, advanced targeting core from Nemetor and Templar class ships. Nerfed stat spread of the Templar class. Removed Thegualsno class reversed Onslaught battleship. Implemented new sprite and ship system for the Nemetor class, implemented new sprite for the Regal class.
changelog.3.0.2: Implemented Iliad and Culmination class vessels, implemented new sprites for the Grox/Goblin Mk.II, Luminance, and Legate class vessels. Fixed bug where (PR) style hull modules counted alongside the base DP of the hull. Added tips. Adjusted some stats.
changelog.3.0.1: Hotfixes for minor issues like modules being selectable, and misaligned weapon mounts
